hero.tagline: A dozen devs. Fourteen days. Everyone gets through.
hero.subtitle: We help solo devs meet Google Play's 12/14 rule by testing each other in synchronized rounds.
hero.note: Dozena organizes the tester swap. Approval is always up to Google.

items.title: 1. Register your app
items.desc: Name, package, closed testing opt-in link, and Google Group link.

items.title: 2. Join the queue
items.desc: Priority for those who need the 12/14 rule.

items.title: 3. 14-day round
items.desc: Setup (48h) → Test (14 days) → Buffer (2 days). Check-in + feedback.

items.title: 4. Everyone gets through
items.desc: No one tests their own app. Reliability ranking included.

commitment.title: The commitment (read before joining)
items: 48h setup: join the round's Google Group and opt in to every other dev's app on the Play Store.
14 days: open all 12 apps, each on at least 2 distinct days, and check in here.
3 written feedbacks (≥ 80 characters) during the round. No one tests their own app.
commitment.foot: ~15 min per day. No-shows sink the round for 12 people — that's why we say it upfront.
